artworks.title: The Infant Shakespeare, Attended by Nature and the Passions
artworks.medium: stipple etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a naked infant sitting in the center with their legs crossed and arms resting on their thighs. A woman leans over the child, with one arm wrapped around the infant and the other under their chin. Another figure, likely female, bends forward nearby in a long gown. Several figures, possibly spirits or muses, observe with distinct expressions. They wear draped attire, leaving their arms and shoulders bare. In the background, a light figure appears above a sheer cloth. The setting is shadowy and cave-like. The artwork includes captions and inscriptions at the bottom.

artworks.title: Ruined Circular Temple
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a historical landscape with ancient architectural ruins, trees, and a group of figures in period clothing. The ruins, including a central structure, are detailed with fine lines capturing textures and architectural details. The color palette is monochrome with muted browns and grays. Linear shading in the sky suggests clouds, adding atmosphere to the scene.

artworks.title: Part of the Remains of Llanphor near Pembroke
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated point of view, displaying a wide view of a horizon with the sky meeting the top of large, crumbling ruins of a building. The ruins have jagged edges, revealing broken and decayed architecture. The painting style is detailed, capturing textures of stone ruins and surrounding vegetation. The color palette consists of shades of gray and brown. A large, winding tree with dense foliage is on the left, while figures interact with oxen and a wooden cart on the right. In the distance, the castle ruins are surrounded by trees and open sky, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Manerbawr Castle from the Inward Court
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts a courtyard of a castle with classical architecture. The horizon is obscured by the castle structures. The style of the buildings is old, with arched windows and battlements. The artwork shows precision in linework and shading to create texture. The color scheme is mostly brown. Figures near a horse-drawn cart are shown engaged in various tasks. A person is standing on a tower, seemingly overseeing the activities.

artworks.title: Part of the Remains of Llanphor near Pembroke
artworks.medium: aquatint, etching, and drypoint, printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a historical ruin in a pastoral landscape. The view is at eye level, showing an expansive scene with the horizon high in the composition. The ruins occupy the middle ground, with walls and towers in a state of decay. A detailed tree is on the left, extending towards the middle of the scene. The style appears to be an etching or engraving, evident in the fine lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia or brown tones. Figures and animals can be seen nearby, including a man leading a cart drawn by horses. The castle ruins dominate the background with trees and vegetation visible. The sky is partially cloudy, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Woodland Village with a Woman on a Footbridge
artworks.artist: Smith of Chichester, John and George
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a rural area. The view is from a slightly elevated point, showing a broad vista. The horizon is framed by a sky with clouds and birds in flight. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing textures of trees and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of sepia or grey. There is a bridge with two figures in the foreground, leading to cottages with thatched roofs and trees. In the background, the landscape extends outward.

artworks.title: Landscape with Travellers
artworks.artist: Smith of Chichester, John and George
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with trees, rocks, hills, clouds in the sky, birds, and two figures in the foreground. The artwork uses fine brushstrokes to create texture and depth in the landscape. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of black, gray, and white.

artworks.title: Maria, Countess of Coventry
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing a seated woman facing the viewer. She has delicate facial features, curly hair with a feathered decoration, and is dressed in an elegant gown with a fur stole. The woman holds a fabric or handkerchief and the background is simple. At the bottom of the etching, there is a signature that reads "Painted and Etched by B. Wilson 1751."

artworks.title: Gowin Knight, M.B., F.R.S.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up, seated in a chair. The subject is facing slightly to the viewer's left, with their right forearm on a surface and their left hand on their lap. They have long, curly hair, a prominent nose, and a composed expression. The individual is dressed in period clothing including a long-sleeved coat with buttons and cuff ruffles, a vest, and a white neck scarf or cravat. In the background, there are indistinct textures resembling a wall, with a small part of a piece of furniture visible on the right side.

artworks.title: Rembrandt's Head by Himself
artworks.artist: Thomas Worlidge, after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait focused on the upper body of a person. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the right, with their face turned slightly toward the viewer, capturing a direct and centered gaze. The person has distinct facial features including a mustache and a somewhat serious expression, along with a head of voluminous, textured hair. They are dressed in a garment adorned with distinct decorations, including a chain with circular elements and a pendant that adds an element of jewelry to the attire. The background is simple and neutral, consisting of a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Mahomet, a Turkish Merchant
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a man with a beard, mustache, thick eyebrows, and a turban. He wears a robe with a fur-lined collar over a striped undergarment. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Jan Cornelisz Sylvius
artworks.artist: Thomas Worlidge, after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body depiction of a man sitting with his torso slightly turned to the left. He has a full beard and mustache with short, receding hair, mostly covered by a cap. He is dressed in a doublet with fur trim and a wide, ruffled collar. The man holds a quill in his right hand and rests his left hand on an open book, pointing at its pages. The portrait is set in an oval frame, and there is a draped curtain visible behind him within the frame. The background outside the oval is a plain sheet with some spots and marks. A signature and written name appear below the image on the paper.

artworks.title: The Royal Academy of Arts
artworks.medium: mezzotint on wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a room filled with men. The men are engaged in an activity around a seated male figure model. The model is positioned on a raised platform. Some men are depicted in 18th-century clothing with drawing tools. The room features classical statues, busts, and framed portraits on the walls. Chandeliers provide lighting in the room.

artworks.title: Jealous Monster
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.6 × 19.8 cm (11 5/8 × 7 13/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring mythical creatures in a chaotic scene. The beings show exaggerated features and expressions while situated in a water setting. Swirling clouds and waves fill the background, adding to the dynamic nature of the scene. The image combines intricate line work with light and shadow play, showcasing motion and tension. The text at the bottom says "Jealous Monster," hinting at a theme of envy-driven conflict.

artworks.title: Falstaff
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, facing slightly to the side with his upper body turned towards the viewer. He has a round face with a full beard, thinning hair, and is wearing a detailed garment. The man is holding a large goblet and the background is an oval shape. Text around the image identifies him as "Falstaff" and includes a quote from Shakespeare.

artworks.title: Beatrice
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts a person named Beatrice in an upper-body profile view. She faces the left side of the frame with her head slightly tilted back, showing her facial features including a prominent nose and well-defined lips. She has curly hair styled close to the scalp and adorned with a turban-like headwrap decorated with pearls. Beatrice wears a flowing gown with intricate detailing on the shoulders and neckline. The background is a simple oval shape with a textured pattern surrounding the detailed portrayal of Beatrice.

artworks.title: York
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper body in a circular frame. He is shown in a three-quarter view, leaning forward with crossed arms. The man's face looks serious and contemplative. He has curly hair, wears a headscarf with ribbon-like decorations, and is dressed in ornate armor with a ruffled collar. The background is a monochrome texture. Above the image, the text reads "YORK," and below is a caption that seems to be a line from a play.

artworks.title: Cassandra
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body in a three-quarter view. The individual faces forward with their right hand raised, index finger extended towards the ear. They have expressive facial features, with wide eyes and slightly parted lips, framed by wavy, shoulder-length hair. A headband or cloth wraps around their head. The person wears a draped garment that hangs off one shoulder. No visible jewelry or objects are present. The background is a simple, shaded oval shape.

artworks.title: Successful Monster
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.6 × 19.2 cm (11 5/8 × 7 9/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mythical creatures entangled together. The scene shows a figure resembling a satyr or faun intertwined with another figure with serpentine elements, like a snake around them. The background includes clouds and foliage. The composition is expressive and dynamic, emphasizing movement in the forms and surrounding elements. The caption below reads "Successful Monster." The style is akin to 18th-century etchings, with a focus on line work and detailed textures.

artworks.title: Lear
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This image depicts a man from the waist up in a seated or standing pose. He has his head tilted upwards with his hand raised to his temple. The man has a furrowed brow, thick beard, and wavy hair swept back. He is wearing a loose-fitting garment with a wide collar and a piece of fabric or sash over his shoulder. The background has swirling lines creating a textured effect around the figure, with the rest left blank within an oval border. The title "LEAR" is displayed above the image, with printed text below including a quote from Shakespeare's "King Lear".

artworks.title: Caliban
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person's upper body within an oval frame. The individual is shown with their head tilted slightly upward and to the side, with a muscular arm and elongated fingers resting on a branch. The facial features are exaggerated, with a prominent brow, wide nose, and full lips, and the hair is wild. The person's clothing is not detailed, but their skin appears textured. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is lightly textured, enclosed in a rectangular frame with a title "CALIBAN" at the top and a script below. The drawing is set against an off-white backdrop with a narrow border around the image.

artworks.title: Edgar
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body view of man named Edgar. He is turned in a three-quarter position with his head facing forward while his right shoulder is slightly turned out. The man has distinctive facial features with marked eyebrows, a straight nose, and a slight beard. His hair is tousled and voluminous with additional adornments such as leaves and small plants interwoven. His bare skin is visible. In his hand, he holds a bundle of wheat. The background is a textured oval, with a caption in the lower part of the frame.

artworks.title: Nature and Genius Introducing Garrick to the Temple of Shakespeare
artworks.artist: British 18th Century, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a group of people in a dynamic composition. The central scene shows a full-length view of multiple figures engaging in various actions. One figure sits atop clouds, with one arm raised and holding a trumpet in the other. Several figures are standing and kneeling around a raised platform, interacting with each other. Among them is a man with curly hair being introduced by another figure. Some appear to be pulling or guiding while others look on. The figures are dressed in flowing garments that drape around them. One figure lies on the ground, partially covered by fabric. The background features a cloudy sky. The scene is set within an ornate frame, which is surrounded by a plain border with some decorative text below the image.

artworks.title: Poet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a waist-length portrait of a person positioned in profile, turned slightly to the back as if looking over their shoulder. The person has distinct, well-defined eyebrows and a piercing gaze, with eyes looking towards the viewer. They have curly dark hair adorned with a laurel wreath. The person wears detailed clothing with a ruffled collar and a cloth draping across their shoulder. They hold a quill pen in their right hand. The background has a stippled texture forming an oval around the figure and the word "POET" inscribed at the top.
